newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alza Corp cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alza Corp cut to buy.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it downgraded Alza Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- said Mylan Laboratories Inc's announcement that it seeks to market a generic version of Alza's hypertension drug Procardia XL could be a potential threat to Alza.
-- said continues to recommend the shares for aggressive growth accounts.
-- said Alza has one of the best research programs in the drug delivery industry.
-- "Ethyol, developed by U.S. Bioscience (Inc ) and marketed by Alza is experiencing low double-digit growth and is unlikely to exceed $25 million in sales this year," he said.
